failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr,
           EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS mon,
           COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM orders
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT m18.mon AS month,
       m17.order_cnt AS orders_2017,
       m18.order_cnt AS orders_2018,
       m18.order_cnt - m17.order_cnt AS growth_cnt,
       ROUND((m18.order_cnt - m17.order_cnt)::numeric / NULLIF(m17.order_cnt, 0) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct
FROM monthly m18
JOIN monthly m17 ON m17.mon = m18.mon AND m17.yr = 2017
WHERE m18.yr = 2018
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12

failures.question: 库存低于安全库存的商品，按仓库、区域、品牌统计数量，列出前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT
  w.warehouse_name,
  r.region_name,
  b.brand_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS low_stock_sku_count
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
LEFT JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = i.product_id
LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
WHERE i.quantity < i.safety_stock
GROUP BY w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name
ORDER BY low_stock_sku_count DESC
LIMIT 20;
failures.firstSql:
SELECT
  w.warehouse_name,
  r.region_name,
  b.brand_name,
  COUNT(*) AS low_stock_sku_count
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
LEFT JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = i.product_id AND pbm.is_current = true
LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
WHERE i.quantity < i.safety_stock
GROUP BY w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name
ORDER BY low_stock_sku_count DESC
LIMIT 20;
